$note: All 67 scored states were visually reviewed on fresh-name, worst-first sheets; refreshed Side chat/tool/terminal pairs were checked separately. Classification is strict about component presence: the native Browser rail button is additional UI in every conversation state because the gateway-served web page has no Electron browser bridge. Those host-only additions are counted, not mislabeled as rasterization or different fixture data. They are not evidence of missing transcript support. Primary surfaces are generally close; large Side chat and middle-history errors are geometry/scroll-layout differences over identical text. A fresh-fixture Home rerun produced byte-identical PNGs for web and Rune in both themes (four SHA-256 equality checks). This is visual parity evidence, not interaction or atomic presentation sign-off.

home-empty.description: Matching hero, starters, composer and four-row sidebar; glyph and analytic shadow rasterization differs.

home-no-project.description: Native adds a folder-browse icon inside the path field; input/button width and hero vertical alignment differ.

sidebar-hidden.description: Native hidden-sidebar toolbar omits web Back/Forward controls; matching centered home content otherwise.

sidebar-project-collapsed.description: Matching collapsed folder and home; disclosure/focus affordance and glyph/shadow edges differ.

sidebar-row-hover.description: Same Caching row hovered; web shows the title/relative-time tooltip, while native shows only the row highlight.

sidebar-focus-view.description: Same eight Focus titles/order; small row/icon metrics, heading controls and home shadows differ.

app-menu-open.description: Same four menu entries; popup height, row rhythm, border and shadow differ slightly.

thread-search-open.description: Same gateway-ranked titles and paths; dialog/input outline, result spacing and shadow differ slightly.

composer-focused.description: Matching focused composer; native caret/focus painting and shadow differ from the caret-suppressed web capture.

composer-text.description: Exact same draft and send state; native caret remains visible at its fixed capture phase; glyph/shadow edges differ.

composer-attachment.description: Same notes.txt bytes, 30 B chip and draft; chip padding/icon, hero vertical position and native caret differ.

composer-slash.description: Same command rows and descriptions; native menu is slightly lower and leaves more hero subtitle visible.

composer-mention.description: Same skill/thread suggestions; native popup top/height, row inset and icons differ, not the underlying catalog.

model-picker-open.description: Same current model and provider catalog; native row density, visible bottom cutoff and popup shadow differ.

model-picker-filtered.description: Same big query and Big Pickle result; native popup is shorter and its top edge/search field sit lower.

project-picker-open.description: Same atlas-api/home recent-project rows and paths; search popup inset, height and shadow differ slightly.

project-open-dialog.description: Native adds an inline folder-browse button; path field is wider and setup hero/button geometry differs.

project-actions-open.description: Same six actions at the measured anchor; native menu rows are more compact, shortening the popup.

project-edit-open.description: Same fields, path and colors; native Upload icon spans the row and URL action/button sizing differs.

project-copy-feedback.description: Same Project path copied notice; native project card is slightly shorter and notice/row spacing differs.

worktree-picker-open.description: Same Local/New worktree choices; native omits the web leading folder icons and selected checkmark; popup is wider.

worktree-new-selected.description: Same new-worktree selection and master branch; native label lacks the web From prefix and chip sizing differs.

worktrees-empty.description: Same empty worktree dialog and explanatory text; tiny dialog height, border and shadow differences.

chat-markdown-top.description: Same opening prompt/headings/list/table; paragraph/list rhythm, bottom fade and Jump to latest visibility differ.

chat-markdown-middle.description: Same full history at 50% scroll; native table/paragraph rhythm displaces the lower code/list and jump control.

chat-markdown-bottom.description: Same numbered list/table/code/end paragraph; native row/list spacing shifts the code block and final line.

chat-long-top.description: Both fully page to the beginning and show turns 1–4; small repeated bubble/text baseline offsets accumulate.

chat-long-middle.description: Both load all 40 turns and scroll to 50%; different total row heights put web near turn 19 and native near turn 20.

chat-long-bottom.description: Same final turns 37–40; repeated bubble/answer spacing and line baselines differ slightly.

chat-tools-bottom.description: Same collapsed 5s work turn and linked answer; disclosure glyph, link icon and text baselines differ.

chat-question-bottom.description: Same real form and unselected choices; native title/choice/footer spacing and radio/button rendering differ.

chat-architecture-bottom.description: Same authored architecture Markdown; list/table row rhythm, checkbox/icon shape and code baseline differ.

chat-subagent-bottom.description: Same parent prompt and answer; near-matching transcript geometry with small bubble/text metrics differences.

chat-checklist-bottom.description: Same checked Tests and unchecked Release items; native checkbox shapes and list/text baselines differ.

chat-external-read-bottom.description: Same caching Markdown and native permission record; rendered history matches, with table/list/code spacing differences. This is not pending-permission-dock coverage.

tools-expanded.description: Same expanded work turn with collapsed activity summary; disclosure marker and summary/answer baselines differ.

tool-rows-expanded.description: Same reasoning and five collapsed tool rows; native adds leading disclosure chevrons and uses slightly different row/icon metrics.

tool-detail-open.description: Only the same Read output is expanded, with bottom scroll normalized; native code/input padding and row disclosure icons differ.

thoughts-expanded.description: Same reasoning text and tool rows; short authored reasoning fits without truncation in both; row chevrons and spacing differ.

question-selected.description: Same Local choice selected; radio inset, choice height, footer/button geometry differ slightly.

question-review.description: Same Local answer in review; native review card begins slightly lower and its answer/footer rows are tighter.

thread-actions-open.description: Same six thread actions; native popup is anchored farther right rather than right-aligning to the trigger; Markdown rhythm also differs.

thread-context-menu.description: Same Caching row and six actions at the measured right-click point; row height/shadow and underlying Markdown spacing differ.

session-details-open.description: Same context, checkout, one changed file, canvas/MCP/skills data; native popover row spacing/height and background Markdown differ.

find-markdown-open.description: Same empty Find field and underlying Markdown; native Find lacks the web raised shadow and has a different outline; transcript spacing differs.

find-long-open.description: Same empty Find field and final long-history turns; native overlay border/shadow and transcript vertical rhythm differ.

panel-changes.description: Same one-file change tree; native review-empty icon differs and tree/header controls shift slightly; narrow main-chat code wraps instead of horizontally clipping.

panel-diff-open.description: Same actual one-line addition in src/index.ts; native path/header icon, diff gutter and toolbar spacing differ; narrow main-chat code wraps differently.

panel-files.description: Same .git/src/README/report tree; native empty-state glyph differs, controls shift slightly and narrow main-chat code wraps differently.

panel-file-open.description: Same README bytes and source view; native tree/file markers, editor toolbar spacing and narrow main-chat wrapping differ.

panel-terminal.description: Same real PTY/prompt and bottom drawer; terminal glyph/cursor outline and tab icons differ; underlying Markdown spacing differs.

panel-side-chat.description: Same first side fork explicitly selected and same inherited Markdown; native transcript starts higher in its scroll extent, has different table/list spacing and a shorter composer; narrow main composer controls reflow differently.

side-chat-new.description: Same newly created real fork selected in both; native side Markdown/table rhythm and composer height differ; only the temporary fork is removed after the pair.

panel-subagents.description: Same real Explore source child, All 1 / Running 0; native header/icon spacing and narrow main composer reflow differ.

subagents-list.description: Same completed Explore source child and counts; native row/header glyphs and narrow main composer layout differ.

subagent-conversation.description: Same real child prompt/answer, not a parent substitute; native reader omits/moves the web beginning label and places Idle at the bottom; narrow composer reflows differently.

settings-general.description: Native adds an OpenCodex Updates card (showing Reading update status in headless mode), shifting the same service/plugin/notification sections down. This is a native-host versus browser-host difference.

settings-general-bottom.description: Both explicitly scrolled to the same bottom sections and paths; native group heights, button insets and wrapped plugin-path text differ slightly.

settings-appearance.description: Same visible mode, font size, terminal placement and theme controls; range-track/knob geometry, segmented controls and row metrics differ.

settings-shortcuts.description: Matching visible shortcut catalog, row positions and keycaps; glyph/border rasterization differs.

settings-projects.description: Matching two actual service projects, order, controls and geometry; glyph and border rasterization differs.

settings-usage.description: Matching empty Usage/Limits content and geometry; glyph/refresh-icon rasterization differs.

settings-remote-access.description: Same off-state fields and no devices; native input/segmented-control insets and card/row dimensions differ slightly.

usage-limits-open.description: Matching empty Usage/Limits page; only text/refresh-icon rasterization differs.

tasks-empty.description: Both real task lists are empty; native assignee/project filter row sits slightly higher and column/header/control spacing differs.

apps-empty.description: Both real app lists are empty; matching empty-state copy, icon and placement with glyph/shadow rasterization differences.

connection-offline.description: Matching unreachable-gateway page, retry button and disabled shell; minor glyph/shadow rasterization differences.
